q: Alkyne molecules are unsaturated hydrocarbons that contain at least one carbon-carbon _____ bond.
e: Alkyne molecules are unsaturated hydrocarbons that contain at least one carbon-carbon triple bond. Unsaturated hydrocarbons have a carbon-carbon double or triple bond, so alkenes, alkynes and aromatics sit in that group. Alkynes are unsaturated hydrocarbons with a carbon-carbon triple bond and the general formula CnH2n-2. Hydrocarbons contain only carbon and hydrogen, joined by covalent bonds.

q: The acetylenic bond is the functional group of an alkyne, and largely dictates the alkyne _____.
e: The acetylenic bond is the functional group of an alkyne, and largely dictates the alkyne reactions. Alkynes are unsaturated hydrocarbons with a carbon-carbon triple bond and the general formula CnH2n-2. A functional group is the atom or group that sets the characteristic reactions of an organic molecule.

q: Alkynes form a homologous series with the general formula _____.
e: Alkynes form a homologous series with the general formula C_nH2n-2. Alkynes are unsaturated hydrocarbons with a carbon-carbon triple bond and the general formula CnH2n-2. A homologous series is a family of compounds with the same functional group and a general formula that rises by CH2. A general formula such as CnH2n+2 describes a whole homologous series at once.

q: The first member of the alkyne series is commonly called _____.
e: The first member of the alkyne series is commonly called acetylene. Alkynes are unsaturated hydrocarbons with a carbon-carbon triple bond and the general formula CnH2n-2.

q: The chains with _____ or more carbon atoms in alkynes lead to the formation of structural isomers.
e: The chains with four or more carbon atoms in alkynes lead to the formation of structural isomers. Alkynes are unsaturated hydrocarbons with a carbon-carbon triple bond and the general formula CnH2n-2. Isomers share a molecular formula but differ in how the atoms are arranged, so their properties differ.

q: An alkyne like $CH_3-C \equiv C-CH_3$ contains no hydrogen on the triple bonded carbon and will _____ form metallic acetylides.
e: An alkyne like CH_3-C equiv C-CH_3 contains no hydrogen on the triple bonded carbon and will not form metallic acetylides. Alkynes are unsaturated hydrocarbons with a carbon-carbon triple bond and the general formula CnH2n-2.

q: The suffix -ane of the alkane is replaced by _____ to name alkynes.
e: The suffix -ane of the alkane is replaced by -yne to name alkynes. Alkanes are saturated hydrocarbons with only single bonds and the general formula CnH2n+2.

q: Reactions of alkynes can be made to add to the carbon-carbon triple bond or to substitute _____ hydrogens.

q: The addition reaction of vinyl bromide is in accordance with _____ rule.
